info.title: QuickSeat API
info.description: REST API for the QuickSeat restaurant reservation platform (Laravel + Sanctum). Every private endpoint is authenticated with a Sanctum Bearer token obtained from /login or /register. Roles: customer, restaurant (manager), admin. Registration requires a verified email via the /email/otp endpoints. In local development MAIL_MAILER=log, so the code is written to storage/logs/laravel.log instead of a real inbox.

sanctumToken.description: Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The token is returned by /login or /register.

managed_restaurants.description: Only populated on the login/register response. Empty unless role is restaurant.

opening_time.description: H:i, used for real availability math.

max_capacity.description: Max guests allowed per single reservation.

cover_image.description: Storage path; not directly usable as a URL.

cover_image_url.description: Public URL to the cover image, if uploaded.

is_full.description: Computed live: true when every available table is currently occupied.

location.description: Short description of where the table sits, shown to customers while booking.

reservation_code.description: Unique display/reference code shown to the customer. Not used as a lookup key by any endpoint today - all lookups are by numeric id.

post.description: Step 1 of registration. Rate-limited to 3 requests/minute per IP. Rejects an email that already belongs to a registered user. The code expires after 10 minutes; requesting a new one invalidates any previous unconsumed code for that email.

200.description: A verification code has been sent to your email.

409.description: This email is already registered. Please log in instead.

429.description: Too many requests - rate limit exceeded (3/minute).

post.description: Step 2 of registration. On success the code is marked consumed and cannot be reused. /register then checks server-side that this email was verified within the last 15 minutes - the code itself does not need to be sent again with the registration form. Max 5 incorrect attempts per code before a new one must be requested. Rate-limited to 10 requests/minute per IP.

422.description: No active code for this email, code expired, code incorrect, or too many attempts.

429.description: Too many requests - rate limit exceeded (10/minute).

post.description: Creates a customer account, or (when account_type=restaurant) a customer account plus a pending RestaurantApplication for admin review - the role stays 'customer' until an admin approves it. Requires the email to have been verified via /email/otp/send + /email/otp/verify within the last 15 minutes, otherwise 422.

password.description: Min 8 chars, upper+lower case, a number and a symbol.

201.description: Registered successfully (customer, or customer + pending restaurant application).

422.description: Validation error (e.g. email already taken, weak password), or the email was not verified via /email/otp within the last 15 minutes.

post.summary: Log in and obtain a Bearer token
post.description: login_as=restaurant additionally requires the account to actually hold the restaurant role (verified server-side from the stored role, not the request).

403.description: login_as=restaurant but the account has no restaurant access, or its restaurant application is pending/rejected.

422.description: Current password incorrect, or new password fails validation / complexity rule.

get.description: Public. Each restaurant includes live-computed is_full / available_tables_now, plus reviews and tables.
Public. Includes reviews.user, tables (with each table's location), and categories.menuItems (the full menu, including unavailable items).

image.description: Max 5MB image. Replaces the existing cover image.

403.description: Not an admin.

post.description: Admin must supply restaurant_id (any restaurant). A restaurant manager may not supply it - their own restaurant is inferred from the token.

table_number.description: Must be unique within the restaurant.

403.description: Not admin/restaurant, or manages no restaurant.

422.description: Validation error, or a table with that number already exists for the restaurant.

patch.description: Admin may update any table; a restaurant manager only a table belonging to their own restaurant.

delete.description: Rejected with 409 if the table has any pending/confirmed reservation - table_id cascades onto reservations at the DB level, so this guard prevents silently deleting a customer's booking.

403.description: Does not manage this table's restaurant.

409.description: This table has active (pending/confirmed) reservations and cannot be deleted.

post.description: The customer is always the authenticated user (never taken from the body). A restaurant-role account may only book at the restaurant it manages. Validates guest capacity, opening hours, table-belongs-to-restaurant, table capacity, and time-overlap availability before creating.

403.description: Account is blocked, or a restaurant account tried to book at a restaurant it doesn't manage.

409.description: The selected table is not available during this time period.

422.description: Guest count exceeds restaurant capacity, time outside opening hours, table doesn't belong to the restaurant, table too small, or an invalid/unavailable menu item.

403.description: Not an admin.

patch.description: The reservation's own customer, an admin, or the restaurant manager that owns this reservation's restaurant may cancel it. Cannot cancel an already-cancelled reservation, or one that has already started.

403.description: Not the reservation's owner, not an admin, and not the manager of this reservation's restaurant.

patch.summary: Mark a reservation as no-show (admin only)

403.description: Not an admin.

409.description: Already cancelled, or already marked no_show.

post.summary: Add dishes to an existing reservation (restaurant manager)
post.description: Restaurant-manager-only in practice: ownership is checked inside the controller (same convention as /menu-items, /categories, /tables), not via route middleware. Adding a menu_item_id that's already on the reservation increases its quantity instead of creating a duplicate row.

200.description: Dishes added to the reservation successfully.

403.description: Caller is not a restaurant manager, or does not manage this reservation's restaurant.

409.description: Cannot add dishes to a cancelled reservation.

422.description: One or more menu items don't belong to (or aren't available in) this restaurant.

get.description: Public. Lets the frontend remove dead time options instead of the customer discovering a slot fails only after picking it.
